standard.summary: 首轮缓存构建时每批编码的图像数。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How many images are encoded per batch during the first-pass cache build.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 首轮缓存构建时每批编码的图像数。1 为逐图串行（慢）；8（默认）批量编码 VAE/Gemma/CLIP，首轮构建约 7× 加速。显存紧张可降到 4。

advanced_en.principle: Images encoded per batch during the first cache build. 1 = serial per-image (slow); 8 (default) batch-encodes VAE/Gemma/CLIP, roughly a 7× speedup on first build. Drop to 4 if VRAM is tight.
